Exercise: Jackknife Sit-Up

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- hip_flexion_hip_extension
- flexion_extension_of_the_spine

Primary Muscles:

- abdominals

Secondary Muscles:
None

Equipment:

- bodyweight

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- core_strength_and_stability
- abdominal_muscle_endurance

Contraindications:

- Individuals with lower back pain or history of disc injuries should avoid this exercise due to the stress on the lumbar spine.

Exercise Variations:

- name: Jackknife Sit-Up with Medicine Ball, equipment: medicine ball
- name: Jackknife Sit-Up with Resistance Band, equipment: resistance band

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Russian Twists, equipment: body only
- exercise_name: Bicycle Crunches, equipment: body only

Instructions:

- Lie flat on the floor (or exercise mat) on your back with your arms extended straight back behind your head and your legs extended also. This will be your starting position.
- As you exhale, bend at the waist while simultaneously raising your legs and arms to meet in a jackknife position. Tip: The legs should be extended and lifted at approximately a 35-45 degree angle from the floor and the arms should be extended and parallel to your legs. The upper torso should be off the floor.
- While inhaling, lower your arms and legs back to the starting position.
- Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
